note: The script asks for four graphics: the question on frame 1, the name super, two more question texts, and the end card. Every other row is captions only. NSF has no logo file in the repo yet, so the end card types the name.

mg.title: Question on frame 1

text.main: Describe the Navy SEAL Foundation in one word.

mg.cue: Question text on frame 1: Describe the Navy SEAL Foundation in one word. Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Question text in the top third, already on screen at 0:00. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05.

mg.title: Name super Jean
mg.cue: Name super at 00:06, lower left, 2 s: Jean Cassidy / Volunteer.
mg.use: Name super from 00:06 for 2 seconds. Type the second line Volunteer under it. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: Question: coming back

text.main: Why do you keep coming back?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:18, top third, 2.5 s: Why do you keep coming back?
mg.use: Top third from 00:18 for 2.5 seconds, while she starts her answer. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Question: golf tip
mg.cue: Question text at 00:36, top third, 2 s: Best golf tip?
mg.use: Top third from 00:36 for 2 seconds. It lands with her own words. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: the Navy SEAL Foundation name in white on NSF blue #003C69, then one line: navysealfoundation.org.
mg.src: No NSF logo file in the repo yet (endcards/ has no NSF entry), so the name is typed until the logo is added. Colours from the NSF client file (navysealfoundation.org, mined 7 Jul 2026).
mg.use: After her last line at 00:44. Hold it to the last frame. No fade to black. The name stands in for the logo until the logo is in the repo.
